listing.name: Digimon World 2003 — dmw2003-shinka (JohnnySn0w)
listing.summary: Experimental Digimon World 2003 project with progression, menu and battle changes. A full campaign has not been confirmed, and no public installer is offered. Follow the source-build instructions below; Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Digimon World 2003 PlayStation disc, Europe SLES03936.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow docs/windows-baseline to prepare your own SLES03936 data and build with the required C++ tools. The build and launch script produces build-windows/Release/dmw2003-shinka.exe. The guided installer is for local testing only; no public installer is offered.

warnings: This experimental project changes progression, menus and battles. A full campaign and installer have not been confirmed. The art/model prototype runs separately and does not replace models in the game.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
